title: skills(project): platform catalog lists the built-in sys_task and sys_note objects
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYo86w1wqy2z2fMrryr

Fixes #37058

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:做应用的 AI 助手在「平台已自带什么」目录里能查到内置的任务和备忘两个对象,需要待办或备忘时直接用平台的,不再自己另建一套。
- 为什么做:平台新带了任务和备忘,目录没跟上,属于起步应用这条线上技能说明的补漏。
- 出错会怎样:写错的话助手会被引到不存在的视图或权限说法上;只动说明文字和一条测评,撤回这一个合并即可。
- 要你做什么:批准合并。只改技能说明文字、一条测评和生成器测试的文本上限;因为教到行级可见性和 `member_default` 授权,契约审核判它「涉及权限」,按需人工批准处理。另有一处小事随批准认可:生成器测试的手写文本上限 1581→1719,先删 47 字节真重复,余额按实测提高(依裁决 6513306068 的 A 路线)。契约审核 PASS:记录 7145995541,Head-sha `1239e77fd649ba695a64a4217bfc9f7cefae3f04`。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/scripts/lib/platform-catalog.ts`: a new group, "Tasks and notes", with one row each for `sys_task` and `sys_note`. The task row spells the navigation entry with `objectName` and `requiresObject` both `sys_task` (`defineStack` refuses a `type: 'object'` entry naming an object the stack does not declare without `requiresObject`); the note row reuses it, naming `sys_note`. The `sys_comment` row's cell reads "a comments or record-notes table" (notes kept on a record still land there; `sys_note` links to no record). Two same-file restatement cuts: `sys_mail_message` points at the `sys_mailbox` row instead of restating it, and `sys_work_calendar_exception` drops ", kept in Setup" (said on `sys_work_calendar`).
- `skills/objectstack-project/references/platform-catalog.md`: regenerated with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:skill-refs`, never hand-edited.
- `skills/objectstack-project/evals/project-process.json`: eval case 10, a to-do request answered with a navigation entry on `sys_task` carrying `requiresObject`, and no new object.
- `packages/spec/scripts/platform-catalog.test.ts`: the hand-written-text ceiling moves from 1581 to 1719 tokens (arithmetic below).
- `.changeset/37058-skills-catalog-sys-task-note.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch. `@objectstack/spec` is not in it: its `files` list ships no `scripts/` path.

Every fact in the two rows was read from the merged code at `63ab4794eb`:

| Fact in the row | Source |
|:--|:--|
| task holds title, status, due time, assignee, platform-written `completed_at` | `packages/platform-objects/src/work/sys-task.object.ts` fields; `work/hooks.ts` writes the stamp |
| note holds a title and a rich-text body | `work/sys-note.object.ts` fields |
| no link to another record | both object docblocks; neither declares a target column |
| task views `assigned_to_me`, `created_by_me`, `all` | `sys-task.object.ts` `listViews` |
| note views `mine`, `all` | `sys-note.object.ts` `listViews` |
| a task is opened by its creator and its assignee | `sharingModel: 'private'` plus the `sys_task_assignee` rule in `work/sharing-rules.ts` |
| a note is read by its creator | `sharingModel: 'private'` |
| `member_default` grants read, create and edit, not delete | `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/default-permission-sets.ts`, the `sys_task` and `sys_note` lines |
| the nav entry needs `requiresObject` | `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` app-navigation cross-ref; pin in `packages/lint/src/validate-object-references.test.ts` |
| data API | neither object declares `enable.apiMethods` |
| mounted on every boot | derived by the generator from `PLATFORM_OBJECTS_BY_PACKAGE` |

### The ceiling move, and the ruling it rests on

The page is generator-owned, so the token ratchet does not price it; its hand-written text has its own shrink-only ceiling in the generator test, and that sat at one token of headroom.

- base: 6320 bytes, 1580 tokens, ceiling 1581
- cut first: 47 bytes of restatement (the `sys_mail_message` and `sys_work_calendar_exception` cells above; "no link to another record" said once for both new rows)
- added: 602 bytes (the group title, the two rows, the `requiresObject` spelling, "record-notes")
- now: 6875 bytes, ceil(6875 / 4) = 1719; the ceiling is pinned at that measurement, 0 headroom

The raise follows the path the test's own comment and the ratchet header name, the maintainer's standing ruling 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 (ruling record 6513306068). The remainder is the card's ordered facts, which deletion cannot pay without cutting other rows' teaching.

- Fix round at `1239e77fd6`: M1 and S1 fixed, N2 and N3 folded in, N1 and N4 left; delta review on that head follows on this PR.

Every other derived family is left to CI on this head.

No ablation: the diff changes generator data, a pin and an eval fixture, and no behaviour a test holds.

Read first, by risk:

1. `packages/spec/scripts/lib/platform-catalog.ts`, the "Tasks and notes" group: every clause against the table above.
2. `packages/spec/scripts/platform-catalog.test.ts`, the `HAND_WRITTEN_CEILING_TOKENS` hunk: the one number that moved up.
